question: P, Q, R, S, T, U and V each have exam on different days of a week starting from Monday and ending on Sunday. P has exam on Tuesday. Q has exam on the day immediately following U's exam. Only three persons have exam between U and T's exam. V has exam on the day immediately following Q's exam. Only two persons have exam between P and U's exam. R does not have exam on Thursday. S has exam on which day?
solution:
